from solution import chkList


def test_issue_example_all_same():
    """Example: chkList(['one','one','one']) == True."""
    result = chkList(['one', 'one', 'one'])
    assert result == True  # 3 items, 3-3=0 differences -> True


def test_issue_all_same_integers():
    """Check whether the elements in a list are same or not."""
    result = chkList([4, 4, 4, 4])
    assert result == True  # 4 items, 4-4=0 differences -> True


def test_issue_all_different_integers():
    """Check whether the elements in a list are same or not."""
    result = chkList([1, 2, 3])
    assert result == False  # 3 items, 3-1=2 extra distinct -> False


def test_issue_single_element():
    """Check whether the elements in a list are same or not."""
    result = chkList([42])
    assert result == True  # 1 item, 1-1=0 differences -> True


def test_issue_two_same_elements():
    """Check whether the elements in a list are same or not."""
    result = chkList([9, 9])
    assert result == True  # 2 items, 2-2=0 differences -> True


def test_issue_two_different_elements():
    """Check whether the elements in a list are same or not."""
    result = chkList([5, 6])
    assert result == False  # 2 items, 2-1=1 difference -> False


def test_issue_middle_element_differs():
    """Check whether the elements in a list are same or not."""
    result = chkList(['a', 'a', 'b', 'a'])
    assert result == False  # 4 items, 4-3=1 differs in middle -> False


def test_issue_mixed_types_differ():
    """Check whether the elements in a list are same or not."""
    result = chkList([1, '1'])
    assert result == False  # 2 items, 1+1=2 compared, 1 != '1' -> False


def test_issue_empty_list_returns_bool():
    """Check whether the elements in a list are same or not."""
    result = chkList([])
    assert result in [True, False]  # 0 items, 0+0=0 -> must be bool without error


def test_contract_returns_bool_when_same():
    """chkList must return True when elements are same."""
    result = chkList([7, 7, 7])
    assert result is True  # 3 items, 3-3=0 differences -> True


def test_contract_returns_bool_when_different():
    """chkList must return False when elements are not same."""
    result = chkList([7, 7, 8])
    assert result is False  # 3 items, 3-2=1 difference -> False


def test_contract_does_not_mutate_input():
    """chkList must check elements without mutating the list."""
    lst = [1, 1, 2]
    chkList(lst)
    assert lst == [1, 1, 2]  # 3 items, 2+1=3 length unchanged -> [1, 1, 2]
